topic_ko: 식물의 다층적 방어와 진화적 군비 경쟁
_note: 순서(논설 과학문) FULL set. 유형마다 passage를 다르게 paraphrase. grammar/vocab의 밑줄 어구는 해당 passage 문장에 글자 그대로 존재. order/insert의 target·text도 동일.

order.given: Plants have evolved defenses almost as diverse as the number of genera. Some load their tissues with harsh compounds that either are unpleasant to insects or intoxicate them, encouraging the insects to go bother another plant or at least slowing down their eating.

blocks.A: The back-and-forth is not a matter of natural balance, but more like a drawn-out evolutionary conversation. New plant defenses unintentionally select for insects with ways to get around them, which in turn help bring about more resilient and resistant plant species. New variations, shading into entire new forms and adaptations, maintain the stalemate.
blocks.B: Plants can release chemical compounds that let their same-species neighbors know that an attack is likely coming, pushing those nearby plants to start building up defensive compounds in their tissues. Some of these cues even attract insect predators, a call for an assist that benefits both the plant and its bug-eating collaborators.
blocks.C: Structural defenses like thick coats of wax on leaves may prevent some insect species from damaging the plant tissues altogether. Nor are individual plants entirely on their own while under attack.

order.explanation_ko: 주어진 글(화학적 방어) 뒤에 (C)에서 구조적 방어로 전환하고 '혼자가 아님'으로 연결하고, (B)에서 이웃 알림·포식자 유인을 구체화하고, (A)에서 '밀고 당기기' 전체를 '진화적 대화'로 총괄한다. (C)-(B)-(A)가 정답.
order.distractor_ko: (A)의 'The back-and-forth'는 (B)(C)의 소통·방어 내용을 전제하므로 맨 앞에 올 수 없다. (C)의 '혼자가 아님'은 (B)의 이웃 소통을 도입하는 연결 고리이므로 반드시 (B) 앞에 있어야 한다.

passage: Plants have developed a vast array of defense mechanisms to cope with insect herbivores.
Some species fill their cells with bitter or toxic chemicals that discourage insects from feeding.
Others have evolved tough physical coatings, such as thick wax layers on leaves, that prevent physical damage.
Beyond these individual defenses, plants are also capable of collective responses.
When attacked, a plant can broadcast chemical signals warning nearby members of the same species.
Those alerted neighbors then begin stockpiling their own defensive compounds before an attack arrives.
Certain signals even summon insect predators that help eliminate the herbivorous threat.
All of this forms part of a long, ongoing evolutionary exchange between plants and the insects that feed on them.
choices: the role of insect predators in controlling plant population
layered defense strategies plants use against insect herbivores
how chemical toxins in plants affect human medicine
the reason insects are attracted to flowering plants
differences in defense mechanisms between tree species and grass species
theme.explanation_ko: 화학적·구조적 방어, 이웃 경보, 포식자 유인을 아우르는 식물의 다층적 방어 전략이 주제이다. ②가 정답.
theme.distractor_ko: ①포식자의 식물 개체수 조절, ③식물 독소와 인간 의약품, ④곤충이 꽃에 이끌리는 이유, ⑤나무와 풀의 방어 차이는 본문 초점이 아니다.

passage: Over millions of years, plants have built up a sophisticated toolkit for resisting insect damage.
Chemical deterrents in plant tissue make insects reluctant to feed or drive them away entirely.
Physical barriers such as waxy leaf coatings provide an additional line of protection.
Nor do plants stand alone: chemical alarm signals alert neighboring plants to prepare their defenses.
Some of those signals even bring in insect predators that attack the herbivores.
Yet insects are not passive victims — over time they evolve ways around every plant defense.
In response, plants evolve newer, stronger measures, and the cycle continues.
The result is not harmony but an endless, escalating arms race between two kingdoms of life.
choices: How Insects Became the Dominant Herbivores on Earth
Plants on Guard: An Endless Evolutionary Arms Race with Insects
The Chemical Language of Flowers: Attracting Pollinators
Why Wax Coatings Are the Most Effective Plant Defense
Cooperation Between Plants and Predators: A New Ecological Theory
title.explanation_ko: 식물이 다양한 방어를 진화시키고 곤충도 이에 맞게 진화하는 끝없는 군비 경쟁이 글의 핵심이다. ②가 제목으로 가장 적절하다.
title.distractor_ko: ①지배적 초식 동물로서의 곤충, ③화분 매개자 유인, ④왁스 코팅의 우수성, ⑤식물-포식자 협력 이론 — 모두 글 전체의 초점이 아닌 부분적 내용이다.

passage: Plants have evolved defenses almost as diverse as the number of genera.
Some load their tissues with harsh compounds that either are unpleasant to insects or intoxicate them, encouraging the insects to go bother another plant or at least slowing down their eating.
Structural defenses like thick coats of wax on leaves may prevent some insect species from damaging the plant tissues altogether.
Nor are individual plants entirely on their own while under attack.

Plants can release chemical compounds that let their same-species neighbors to know that an attack is likely coming, pushing those nearby plants to start building up defensive compounds in their tissues.
Some of these cues even attract insect predators, a call for an assist that benefits both the plant and its bug-eating collaborators.
The back-and-forth is not a matter of natural balance, but more like a drawn-out evolutionary conversation.
New plant defenses unintentionally select for insects with ways to get around them, which in turn help bring about more resilient and resistant plant species.
grammar.explanation_ko: ④ 사역동사 let은 목적보어로 원형부정사를 취한다. 'let their neighbors to know'에서 to know → know로 고쳐야 한다.
grammar.distractor_ko: ①as diverse as — 동등 비교 as ... as, ②encouraging — 결과를 나타내는 분사구문, ③from damaging — prevent A from V-ing 구문, ⑤which in turn — 앞 절 전체를 받는 계속적 관계대명사. 모두 문법상 올바르다.

passage: Plants have evolved defenses almost as diverse as the number of genera.
Some load their tissues with harsh compounds that either are unpleasant to insects or intoxicate them, encouraging the insects to go bother another plant or at least slowing down their eating.
Structural defenses like thick coats of wax on leaves may prevent some insect species from damaging the plant tissues altogether.
Nor are individual plants entirely on their own while under attack.

Plants can release chemical compounds that let their same-species neighbors know that an attack is likely coming, pushing those nearby plants to start building up defensive compounds in their tissues.
Some of these cues even repel insect predators, a call for an assist that benefits both the plant and its bug-eating collaborators.
The back-and-forth is not a matter of natural balance, but more like a drawn-out evolutionary conversation.
New plant defenses unintentionally select for insects with ways to get around them, which in turn help bring about more resilient and resistant plant species.
vocab.explanation_ko: ④ 식물의 신호들은 해충을 잡아먹는 곤충 포식자를 '유인(attract)'해야 하는데, 'repel(쫓아내다)'이 쓰여 문맥상 부적절하다. → repel을 attract로 고쳐야 한다.
vocab.distractor_ko: ①intoxicate(중독시키다) — 화합물의 기능으로 적절, ②altogether(전혀) — 완전 차단 강조로 적절, ③release(방출하다) — 화학 화합물을 내보내는 행위로 적절, ⑤resilient(회복력 있는) — 더 강해진 식물 묘사로 적절.

passage: Plants have evolved a remarkable variety of defenses against insect herbivores.
Some species rely on chemical deterrents — toxic or unpleasant compounds loaded into plant tissues.
Others use physical barriers, such as thick waxy coatings on leaves, to prevent insect damage entirely.
Plants also cooperate: they release chemical signals that warn neighboring members of the same species.
Those neighbors then begin stockpiling defensive compounds before an attack can reach them.
Certain signals go further, recruiting insect predators to eliminate the feeding insects.
Underlying all of this is an arms race: new plant defenses give rise to insects that can overcome them.
The result is not a stable equilibrium but __________.
New variations on both sides continuously maintain this unresolved competition.
blank.blank_target: The result is not a stable equilibrium but __________.
choices: a final victory for plant species
an immediate collapse of insect populations
a permanent chemical barrier between plants and insects
blank.explanation_ko: 앞 문장에서 새 방어책이 새 곤충을 낳는다고 했고, 뒤 문장에서 '계속 유지되는 미해결 경쟁'이 이어진다. 따라서 빈칸에는 승자 없이 오래 이어지는 '진화적 대화(a drawn-out evolutionary conversation)'가 들어가야 한다.
blank.distractor_ko: ②식물의 최종 승리, ③곤충 생물다양성 감소, ④곤충 개체수 즉각 붕괴, ⑤영구적 화학 장벽 — 모두 끝없는 군비 경쟁이라는 본문의 결론과 어긋난다.

insert.insert_sentence: Nor are individual plants entirely on their own while under attack.

passage_marked.text: Plants have evolved defenses almost as diverse as the number of genera.
Some load their tissues with harsh compounds that either are unpleasant to insects or intoxicate them, encouraging the insects to go bother another plant or at least slowing down their eating.
Structural defenses like thick coats of wax on leaves may prevent some insect species from damaging the plant tissues altogether.

Plants can release chemical compounds that let their same-species neighbors know that an attack is likely coming, pushing those nearby plants to start building up defensive compounds in their tissues.
Some of these cues even attract insect predators, a call for an assist that benefits both the plant and its bug-eating collaborators.

insert.explanation_ko: 주어진 문장 'Nor are individual plants entirely on their own while under attack'는 부정(Nor) 도치 구문으로, 구조적 방어(왁스 코팅)에 이어 '그뿐만 아니라 식물은 혼자가 아니다'라는 전환을 이룬다. 이어서 ④에서 이웃과의 화학적 소통이 구체적으로 설명된다. 따라서 ③ 뒤가 정답.
insert.distractor_ko: ①② 뒤에 놓으면 구조적 방어(③)가 협력 설명 뒤로 밀려 흐름이 역전된다. ④⑤ 뒤에 놓으면 이미 협력 내용이 나온 뒤이므로 '혼자가 아님'이라는 도입이 너무 늦다.

passage: Plants have evolved chemical and physical defenses to protect themselves from insect herbivores.
Some fill their tissues with toxic compounds, while others rely on thick wax coatings to prevent physical damage.
Beyond individual defenses, plants communicate with each other by releasing alarm chemicals.
These signals warn neighboring plants to build up defensive compounds and may even recruit insect predators.
Every new plant defense, however, tends to select for insects that can overcome it.
Those adapted insects in turn drive the evolution of newer, tougher plant species.
The relationship is therefore not a natural equilibrium but a prolonged arms race.
New variations on both sides continuously preserve the stalemate.
summary.summary_template: Plants protect themselves through both __(A)__ defenses and collective chemical communication, yet these adaptations fuel an endless evolutionary __(B)__ with insects.
summary.explanation_ko: 식물의 다층적(layered) 방어와 소통이 오히려 끝없는 진화적 군비 경쟁(arms race)을 촉발한다는 것이 글의 결론이다. ①이 정답.
summary.distractor_ko: (A) passive(수동적) 또는 aggressive(공격적)는 본문의 '다층 방어' 의미를 잘못 표현한다. (B) cooperation(협력), retreat(후퇴)는 본문의 군비 경쟁 결론과 어긋난다.

writing.question: 다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 <보기>의 단어를 모두 배열하여 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 잎의 두꺼운 왁스 코팅과 같은 구조적 방어 수단은 일부 곤충 종이 식물 조직을 전혀 손상시키지 못하도록 막을 수 있다.
writing.answer: Structural defenses like thick coats of wax on leaves may prevent some insect species from damaging the plant tissues altogether.
writing.explanation_ko: prevent A from V-ing 구문(A가 ~하지 못하도록 막다). Structural defenses(주어) + may prevent(동사) + some insect species(목적어) + from damaging ... altogether.

writing.question: 다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 <보기>의 단어를 모두 배열하여 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 이 밀고 당기기는 자연적 균형의 문제가 아니라 길게 이어지는 진화적 대화에 가깝다.
writing.answer: The back-and-forth is not a matter of natural balance, but more like a drawn-out evolutionary conversation.
writing.explanation_ko: not A, but (more like) B 구조. 'A가 아니라 B에 가깝다'. drawn-out(길게 이어지는) + evolutionary(진화적인) 형용사 순서 주의.

writing.question: 다음 우리말을 <조건>에 맞게 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 새로운 식물 방어 수단은 의도치 않게 그것을 우회하는 방법을 가진 곤충을 선택하고, 이는 다시 더 회복력 있고 저항성 있는 식물 종의 출현을 촉진한다.
conditions: 관계대명사 which를 계속적 용법으로 사용할 것
writing.answer: New plant defenses unintentionally select for insects with ways to get around them, which in turn help bring about more resilient and resistant plant species.
writing.explanation_ko: select for(~를 선택적으로 살아남게 하다), which in turn(차례로, 연결 역할의 계속적 관계대명사), more resilient and resistant(비교급 형용사 병렬).

writing.question: 다음 밑줄 친 문장을 우리말로 해석하시오.
writing.en_prompt: Plants can release chemical compounds that let their same-species neighbors know that an attack is likely coming, pushing those nearby plants to start building up defensive compounds in their tissues.
writing.answer: 식물은 화학 화합물을 방출하여 같은 종의 이웃 식물에게 공격이 곧 올 것 같다고 알리고, 그 주변 식물들이 조직 내에 방어 화합물을 축적하기 시작하도록 한다.
writing.explanation_ko: let + 목적어 + 원형부정사 know(알리다), that절(공격 임박), 분사구문 pushing ... to start building up(결과: ~하도록 밀어붙인다).

writing.question: 다음 글을 읽고, 요약문의 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 단어를 본문에 근거하여 쓰시오.
writing.summary: Plants use both chemical and structural defenses to resist insect herbivores, and they can also (A)___________ chemical signals to warn neighbors and attract predators; however, these measures fuel an ongoing evolutionary (B)___________ as insects continually adapt to overcome them.
writing.explanation_ko: (A) 화학 화합물을 '방출하다' = release. (B) 군비 경쟁의 결과는 승자 없는 '교착 상태' = stalemate. 둘 다 본문에 그대로 등장하는 단어.

writing.question: 다음 우리말을 <조건>에 맞게 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 또한 개별 식물이 공격받는 동안 완전히 혼자인 것도 아니다.
conditions: Nor로 시작하여 도치 구문을 사용할 것
writing.answer: Nor are individual plants entirely on their own while under attack.
writing.explanation_ko: Nor + 조동사(are) + 주어(individual plants) 도치. entirely on their own(완전히 혼자서), while under attack(공격받는 동안 — 분사구문 생략 형태).
